description:
Get 20% off DeleteMe by going to https://joindeleteme.com/SCISHOW and use code SCISHOW to protect your privacy!  

If you're a content creator on YouTube, thumbnails are super important because they help entice people to click on a video. But the fact that you also have thumbnails *on your thumbs* is also mighty helpful, whether you're a content creator, a human watching that content, or even a squirrel. Why do we have nails instead of claws, and how did our ancestors evolve into having them?

Hosted by: Madelyn Leembruggen (she/her)
